description.value: A motel on Highway 31 in the Kootenays region of southeastern British Columbia, positioned along a major cycling touring corridor. Serves as overnight accommodation for travelers and cyclists passing through the area. The location provides a convenient rest stop for bicycle touring routes in the region.
